entries.content: Transforming a character into a body part, or into a part of another character's body, may be done through a variety of means.

entries.name: Body Swapping
entries.content: The act of two or more individuals swapping bodies through consciousness transfer, enabling them to inhabit the other's body.

entries.name: Gender Transformation
entries.content: Transforming a person into another gender by various means, which may or may not include their sex. Encompasses both magical and sci-fi changes, as well as more realistic gender reassignment.

entries.name: Inanimate Object Transformation
entries.content: Transforming a character into an object of sorts (a chair, clothing, a toy, etc.), may be done through a variety of means.

entries.name: Species Transformation
entries.content: Transforming a character into another species other than their own, may be done through a variety of means.

entries.name: Supernatural Transformation
entries.content: Transforming a character into a supernatural entity such as a vampire, werebeast, demon, god, and other such varied mythical figures. May be done through a variety of means.

entries.name: Alternative Pregnancy
entries.content: Pregnancy that takes place in areas of the body other than the womb through vaginal means, such as the breasts, balls, limbs, tail, and so on.

entries.name: Breeding
entries.content: Entails the act sexual intercourse for the sole purpose of inducing pregnancy and / or producing offspring.

entries.name: Birthing
entries.content: Scenes in which someone goes into labor or gives birth; participants may derive sexual gratification from the experience.

entries.name: Extreme Pregnancy
entries.content: The act of becoming pregnant with an incredible or unrealistic size and / or number of fetuses / eggs, often in an unrealistically short time span, and often to the point of immobility.

entries.name: Heat
entries.content: A character entering a state of heightened sexual arousal which often alters or overrides their inhibitions. May correspond with being more receptive to impregnation / the ability to impregnate.

entries.name: Male Pregnancy
entries.content: The act of a male identifying person becoming pregnant or at least one male character is pregnant.

entries.name: Oviposition
entries.content: in which at least one person will lay eggs through an orifice.

entries.name: Exhibitionism
entries.content: Engaging in some kind of play where one or both parties will be caught, spotted, or otherwise observed by a third party or parties, adding to the thrill (and / or humiliation).
